subject: Staged commit schedule for Dedicated capacity - Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimbushealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased Dedicated ramp

Aditya —

Thanks for the earlier call. Nimbus leadership asked me to put the ask in writing so we can align procurement and finance. High level: we want a Dedicated capacity contract with a staged capacity commit over 12–24 months. Rough numbers: start at 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (baseline) with a plan to ramp to 24 GPUs over year one, maybe 36 by year two.

Questions we need answered before procurement will move forward: 
- What discounts do you offer for 12mo and 36mo prepay? Any additional tier for commit > $1M ARR?
- Can we phase the commitment (e.g., 25% / 50% / 25%) with clear billing start dates?
- How are true-ups handled if we exceed committed throughput (tokens/s or TPM)? Overage rates?
- Do you support scheduled burst windows without additional reservation cost?
- We will need a sample term sheet and an SLA with latency SLOs tied to credits.

I attached a quick budget file (Nimbus_budget_v2.xlsx) — it shows target spend bands.

If you can share a draft commercial structure and an example ramp schedule we can review, procurement will queue legal.

Best,
Daniel
Head of AI Platforms
Nimbus Health
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased Dedicated ramp

Daniel —

Appreciate the clear ask and the budget file; that helps a lot. Quick answers up front and then a few clarifying items so we tailor the term sheet: 

Summary (high level):
- Discounting: we typically offer a 10–15% discount for a 12-month full prepay and 18–25% for a 36-month full prepay depending on committed spend. We also provide an additional volume tier for deals > $1M ARR (can unlock an extra 3–5%).
- Phased commits: we support staged commitments. Typical cadence is quarterly ramp (e.g., 25/50/25 or 25/25/25/25); billing for each tranche starts on its activation date.
- True-ups & overages: We do monthly true-ups. If you exceed committed throughput, overage is billed at a discounted overage rate (typically 1.2x the unit rate in the committed tranche).
- Burst windows: we can provide scheduled burst capacity (pre-booked windows) at a small premium or allow burst to shared pool subject to available spare capacity; we can codify preferred approach in the SOW.
- SLA & credits: we can include latency and availability SLOs tied to credits; specific thresholds depend on model family and sequence length distribution. Monica will add recommended SLOs.

Clarifying items:
1) When you say 24 GPUs by year one, do you mean 24 guaranteed (reserved) GPUs or 24 peak capacity (including burst)?
2) Do you expect the workload to be mostly generation (long-context) or embedding/short calls? TPM profile affects kernel selection and SLOs.
3) Is Nimbus planning to sign an annual prepay or a multi-year contract with annual payments?

I will circulate a draft commercial term sheet (pricing + ramp table) once Monica confirms the technical constraints. Lauren — looping you for commercial/redline. Monica — can you add a short note on guaranteed vs burst capacity operationally?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased Dedicated ramp

Daniel / team —

Quick technical note on how we typically model staged commitments for Dedicated: 

- Reserved vs peak: reserved (guaranteed) GPUs are allocated to your pool and reduce noisy-neighbor variance. Peak/peak-capacity includes reserved + allowed bursts against a shared pool. For predictable latency, recommend reserving baseline capacity.
- Ramp mechanics: we schedule tranche activation dates (e.g., month 1, month 4, month 7) and we provision capacity 72–120 hours before activation for warm-up and health checks.
- True-up metric: we measure committed capacity as reserved GPU-hours and a negotiated tokens-per-minute (TPM) baseline for high-throughput short calls. True-ups run monthly; for models with long context we prefer tracking GPU-hours.
- Overages: Overage billing is split: short-term burst under a shared pool billed at a lower transient overage rate; sustained exceed (> 48 hours) triggers automatic scale or rebilling at the reserved rate.
- SLA impact: availability and median tail latency SLOs are per-route and depend on model family. We can tier SLOs by tranche if you want faster service for later tranches.

Operational asks for Nimbus (to minimize surprises):
1) Provide expected 90th / 95th percentile sequence lengths or a representative sample of API traces.
2) Confirm preferred activation cadence (monthly vs quarterly).
3) Indicate whether you want guaranteed GPUs for each tranche or prefer a lower guaranteed + burst model.

I'll follow up with a short appendix describing how we calculate credits (example thresholds + credit formula).

—Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimbushealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased Dedicated ramp

Thanks Aditya / Monica — helpful. A few follow-ups and a counter-proposal on the ramp: 

Counter-proposal: 
- Year 1 (12 months) commit: 24 total reserved GPUs, with an initial activation at 8 GPUs (months 1–3), then 16 GPUs (months 4–7), then 24 GPUs (months 8–12). So: 8 / 16 / 24. Billing for each tranche begins when the tranche becomes reserved.
- Year 2 optional extension: scale to 36 GPUs for year 2 if we elect to renew; we want the 2nd year pricing to be locked at a pre-agreed discount band if we opt in.

Discount asks: 
- 12mo prepaid (upfront): target 18% off list for the Year 1 committed spend if we prepay Year 1 in full.
- 36mo prepaid (upfront): target 27% off list across the full committed spend.
- If we do staged payments (not full prepay), we'd want the same discount band applied pro rata to each tranche.

Other asks: 
- Can you include a one-time onboarding credit or setup fee waiver if we sign a 36mo deal?
- We require a procurement-friendly invoice cadence (annual with PO) and a DocuSign flow for signature.

Attached: Nimbus_budget_v2.xlsx — you can see our planned spend ramp and procurement timelines.

If you can send a draft term sheet with the 8/16/24 ramp and the discount bands, procurement can get legal ready.

Best,
Daniel
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Aug 2025 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased Dedicated ramp

Daniel —

Attached is a draft term sheet (nimbus-dedicated-term-sheet-v3.pdf) that incorporates your 8 / 16 / 24 ramp and lays out two pricing options: 

Option A — 12-month prepay (Year 1 prepaid):
- Commit: 24 reserved GPUs Year 1 (phased activation: 8 / 16 / 24 as you proposed)
- Discount: 18% off list if Year 1 is prepaid in full at signing
- Monthly true-up on usage; overage at 1.25x unit rate for sustained exceed
- Onboarding credit: $25k one-time if signed within 30 days

Option B — 36-month prepay (3-year prepaid):
- Commit: 24 GPUs Year 1, option to scale to 36 Year 2/3 (price locked if exercised)
- Discount: 27% off list across committed spend when fully prepaid
- Additional volume tier: deals > $1.2M ARR get an extra 4% off
- Waived setup fee and $35k onboarding credit

Other commercial points:
- Tranche billing: each activation generates its own invoice if not prepaid; if you choose prepaid we will issue an annual invoice covering the tranches scheduled in that year.
- SLA: included draft SLA with credits; Monica and our legal team will tighten language around availability and latency percentiles.
- DocuSign: included placeholder DocuSign link in the term sheet; we can change to Nimbus PO flow as needed.

Notes / open items: 
1) Confirm whether you want year-1 prepaid in full (Option A) or to negotiate the 36mo Option B. Both are feasible; Option B gives the best unit economics.
2) Confirm tranche activation dates and whether you want guaranteed GPUs for every tranche. Recommend guaranteed GPUs for months 8–12 when you expect peak traffic.

I'll keep myself available for a quick pricing sync tomorrow if you want to run the term sheet line-by-line.

—Lauren Bishop
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Lauren / Aditya —

We reviewed Option A and Option B with finance and procurement. High-level: Option B (36mo prepaid) looks the most attractive and we want the onboarding credit + setup fee waiver. Pending legal review of the SLA language and a short procurement questionnaire, we are prepared to sign the 36mo prepaid term sheet with the 8/16/24 activation schedule for Year 1 and an option to scale to 36 GPUs in Year 2.

- Copy procurement (procurement@nimbushealth.com) on the DocuSign envelope and send the PO instructions.
- Legal will return a single redline for SLA language; please expect that within 72 hours.

Daniel
